name: brainstorming
activation: Creative/new behavior request; trivial fully specified request may execute directly; opt-out ends workflow.
workflow: Inspect existing context; resolve consequential unknowns; compare approaches; write short/full design; project gets builder-check; obtain design approval; invoke writing-plans.
inputs: Request, project/source context, earlier decisions, constraints.
outputs: Approved design and explicit builder choices.
approval_gates: Approach/design approval before product code/scaffolding/install; opt-in visual server; explicit throwaway spike and opt-out exceptions.
costs: Human turns; full canonical skill read; project adds 1 builder-check agent; optional local Node server/browser and external logo request.
failure_modes: Over-questioning or reopening decisions; gate delays routine work; click event mistaken for authority; persisted companion keys/screens; default external logo.
director_action: Use only when material scope/design uncertainty remains; preserve existing authorization; keep explicit decisions in core; visual companion optional and isolated.
verification: static source analysis; upstream scripts/hooks/tests not executed

name: diagnosing-superpowers
activation: User reports session cost/time/quality/skill failure or requests evidence/bug bundle.
workflow: Scope intake; resolve verified session paths and record meanings; seven parallel analyst dimensions; synthesize line-cited report; optional issue search/export/similar-session scan.
inputs: Problem statement, session/child transcripts, environment provenance, optional redaction lists.
outputs: Evidence-backed case and report; optional scrubbed bundle/issue draft.
approval_gates: Intake before broad analysis; export only on request; exact issue/comment text approval; archive only after scrub log/file list approval.
costs: 7 mandatory analysts before optional scrubber+auditor repetitions and per-candidate matchers; transcript extraction overhead.
failure_modes: Fixed seven-agent fanout for narrow issue; wrong usage-counter semantics; LLM scrub false negatives; provenance drift; bars proposing a fix even after evidence.
director_action: Adopt bounded extraction/evidence/provenance; dispatch only relevant dimensions under a cap; distinguish diagnosis from authorized fixes; deterministic secret scanning plus human export approval.
verification: static source analysis; upstream scripts/hooks/tests not executed

name: dispatching-parallel-agents
activation: At least two independent tasks with no shared state/dependency; examples emphasize independent test failures.
workflow: Partition by problem domain; craft clean scoped prompts; dispatch concurrently; inspect all reports/conflicts; run integrated suite.
inputs: Independent scopes, failure messages, constraints, expected report.
outputs: Per-domain root cause/change report plus integrated checked changes.
artifacts: No prescribed durable artifact or machine scheduler.
approval_gates: No dedicated human gate; requires independence and non-interference.
costs: K agent contexts; parallel wall time may fall while tokens/workers rise; integration check required.
failure_modes: False independence, concurrent writes/tests, context starvation, summary trusted as proof.
director_action: Core scheduler owns budget, dependency graph, file ownership/locks, cancellation; permit parallelism only from checked task boundaries.
verification: static source analysis; upstream scripts/hooks/tests not executed

name: executing-plans
activation: Approved implementation plan with user-selected native/inline execution or no subagent tool.
workflow: Isolated worktree; plan workspace/ledger; preflight interface checks; task-start brief+BASE; inline RED/GREEN steps; task-done test gate+ledger; final whole-branch review; one TDD fix pass; finish.
inputs: Plan, spec/global constraints, task number, recorded BASE, test argv.
outputs: Committed task ranges with test results, final review, exhaustive rulings/deferred minors.
approval_gates: Plan/method selection upstream; main-branch explicit consent; four stop categories: destructive, security-sensitive, outside-worktree consequential effect, unusably broken plan.
costs: One continuing implementer context plus 1 final reviewer; no per-task review agents; per-step tests/task completion command and final suite costs.
failure_modes: Compaction/ledger spoof or staleness; ignored scratch deleted; exit-zero command overclaimed; one-pass fixes lack fresh re-review; rulings may exceed user's budget.
director_action: Default cost-sensitive coding lane; persist typed evidence in core store, hash code/commands, gate severity/budget in code, avoid unconditional cleanup and capability-tier assumptions.
verification: static source analysis; upstream scripts/hooks/tests not executed

name: finishing-a-development-branch
activation: Implementation complete and tests pass; integration decision required.
workflow: Fresh suite; inspect git/worktree/branch; resolve fork base; present merge/PR/keep options; execute authorized choice; re-test merged result; cleanup owned worktree.
inputs: Branch/base, git worktree state, project test command, owner's integration choice.
outputs: Merged branch, PR URL, or retained worktree; optional explicitly confirmed discard.
artifacts: Git commits, branch, worktree, PR; no standalone report prescribed.
approval_gates: Integration is owner's decision; exact 'discard' confirmation for destruction; never force cleanup of unique files; force-push only explicit request.
costs: Fresh suite before menu and after merge; git/network/forge calls; human decision.
failure_modes: Directory-name cleanup provenance heuristic misidentifies host-owned worktree; implicit pull changes base; redundant menu despite existing authorization; stale base.
director_action: Core records actual workspace creator/base/authority; reuse scoped owner authorization; preserve uncommitted evidence; no directory-name-only cleanup.
verification: static source analysis; upstream scripts/hooks/tests not executed

name: receiving-code-review
activation: Review feedback arrives, especially unclear/technically doubtful suggestions.
workflow: Read; understand; verify against actual code; evaluate impact; respond/push back; fix one item and test; clarify related uncertainties first.
inputs: Review findings, actual source/tests/platform constraints, owner decisions.
artifacts: No mandatory file; may reply to exact forge review thread.
approval_gates: Discuss conflicts with owner decisions; ask when verification/scope unclear; sending a reply still needs external-message authorization.
costs: Focused source reads and tests per finding; no mandatory agent spawn.
failure_modes: Global stop on one unclear independent item stalls unrelated work; rigid social prohibitions obscure useful communication; external feedback treated as authority.
director_action: Adopt skeptical technical evaluation and evidence; process independent clear items while scoping unresolved dependencies; keep communication policy in core.
verification: static source analysis; upstream scripts/hooks/tests not executed

name: requesting-code-review
activation: Major feature completion, each SDD task, before merge; optional debugging/refactor.
workflow: Capture correct BASE/HEAD; fresh-context reviewer compares diff to requirements; classify Critical/Important/Minor; fix blockers/push back with evidence.
inputs: Description, requirements/spec/plan, BASE/HEAD or review package.
outputs: Line-cited findings, strengths, assessment and merge readiness.
artifacts: code-reviewer.md template; diff/package and report in execution workspace when caller supplies them.
approval_gates: Review is read-only; Critical/Important normally block; reviewer cannot spawn more reviewers.
costs: At least 1 reviewer context per invocation; broad review reads cross-code risks; SDD can already supply same seat.
failure_modes: Default HEAD~1 truncates multi-commit task; duplicate review seats via overlapping skills; report claims mistaken for executed evidence.
director_action: Single review owner per code range; pin evidence to actual commit/content hash; use recorded task BASE; risk-weighted validation and tools enforced read-only.
verification: static source analysis; upstream scripts/hooks/tests not executed

name: subagent-driven-development
activation: Implementation plan with mostly independent tasks, user selected subagent route.
workflow: Workspace/ledger and preflight; serial clean-context implementer; combined spec+quality task review; capped fix loop; mark reviewed/parked completion; one broad final review/fix wave; finish.
inputs: Plan/spec/global constraints, isolated worktree, task brief, implementer report, correct diff range, prior rulings.
outputs: Task commits, two verdicts from one task reviewer, ledger/rulings, broad final review.
approval_gates: Same four stop categories as inline; no main implementation without consent; review blockers can be parked at five-round cap with ruling; workers/reviewers cannot spawn.
costs: For N tasks: N implementers+N combined task reviewers+1 final reviewer baseline; resumed implementers/re-reviewers for fix rounds; models explicitly selected.
failure_modes: Claimed task complete can include parked serious findings; serial workers limit throughput; model assumptions/override conflict; ignored evidence removed at finish; testing reports remain model-authored.
director_action: Optional higher-assurance lane; core enforces budget/role scopes/state and cannot mark blocked defects verified; preserve evidence and reject cap override by prose ruling.
verification: static source analysis; upstream scripts/hooks/tests not executed

name: systematic-debugging
activation: Bug, test failure, unexpected behavior, build/performance/integration issue.
workflow: Reproduce/read errors/recent changes; instrument component boundaries; trace origin; compare working pattern; one hypothesis/minimal experiment; failing regression; focused root fix; verify; reassess architecture after three failures.
outputs: Root-cause hypothesis supported by evidence, regression test and verified repair or explicit limitation.
artifacts: No fixed report; support root-cause-tracing, defense-in-depth, condition-based-waiting, find-polluter.sh.
approval_gates: Root-cause investigation before fix; architectural discussion after 3 unsuccessful fixes.
costs: Investigation and hypothesis iterations; no mandatory subagents; polluter helper runs tests serially.
failure_modes: Boundary instrumentation may reveal secrets; architecture stop can stall bounded recovery; helper called bisection is linear npm test loop and swallows exits.
director_action: Adopt hypothesis/evidence loop; redact before logging, select native runner, bounded experiment caps; use regression evidence rather than unverified statistical claims.
verification: static source analysis; upstream scripts/hooks/tests not executed

name: test-driven-development
workflow: Behavior test first; confirm intended failure; minimal code; focused and whole-suite green; refactor while green; independently derive expected values/mutation thought check.
inputs: Behavior/spec, real production boundary, project runner.
outputs: Regression-protecting tests and implementation with RED/GREEN evidence.
artifacts: Code/tests; writing-good-tests reference; no machine-enforced event log.
approval_gates: Exceptions for throwaway/generated/config ask owner; code-before-tests prompts deletion/rewrite.
costs: At least RED+GREEN runner executions per behavior plus suite before done; no mandatory model spawn.
failure_modes: Blanket delete/start-over destroys valid work; ritual tests mirror implementation; full-suite duplication through other skills; mock evidence misread; inconsistent trivial-test guidance.
director_action: Require regression-first for behavior bugs and meaningful tests for change risk; preserve user code; record baseline/RED/GREEN evidence in core and dedupe unchanged-tree runs.
verification: static source analysis; upstream scripts/hooks/tests not executed

name: using-git-worktrees
activation: Feature isolation or before implementation-plan execution.
workflow: Detect existing linked worktree and exclude submodule false positives; honor preference/consent; native worktree tool first, git fallback; verify ignored path; setup dependencies; clean baseline.
inputs: Actual git/common-dir/branch, user preference, native-tool availability, package manifests.
outputs: Isolated ready workspace or explicit in-place fallback and baseline status.
approval_gates: Consent absent declared preference; ask whether to proceed past baseline failure; user decline permits in-place work.
costs: Git detection/creation, dependency installs/build/download, full baseline suite; no mandatory agent.
failure_modes: Setup triggers install scripts/network before separate safety check; creates extra ignored commits; permission fallback silently reduces isolation; path-based cleanup mismatch.
director_action: Core workspace manager and provenance; approved setup recipe and cached dependencies; isolate untrusted install/build/test operations; clearly record fallback.
verification: static source analysis; upstream scripts/hooks/tests not executed

name: using-superpowers
activation: Session startup/bootstrap or metadata auto-discovery; explicitly skipped by assigned subagents.
workflow: Load all relevant skills before any action at a 1% applicability threshold; process skills first; platform-specific tool adaptation; create checklist todos.
inputs: Task text, skill descriptions/catalog, harness tool list/user instructions.
outputs: Selected skill invocation/read and procedural routing; no executor or permission enforcement.
artifacts: Injected bootstrap in model context; optional todo list.
approval_gates: User instructions outrank skills; actual host policies still control actions.
costs: 492-word bootstrap plus selected skill/reference reads and per-message classification; possible duplicate injection/reloads.
failure_modes: Over-triggering, prompt priority conflicts, recursive bootstrap, platform mapping drift; categorical instruction cannot enforce tools/budget.
director_action: Reject wholesale global mandatory bootstrap in DIRECTOR; keep curated metadata-driven registry, one selector, controller/worker distinction and explicit authority hierarchy.
verification: static source analysis; upstream scripts/hooks/tests not executed

name: verification-before-completion
workflow: Identify proving command; run fully; inspect output/exit; compare to claim; report supported status or actual gaps; independently inspect delegated results.
inputs: Specific claim, exact code state, adequate verifier command and observed result.
artifacts: No fixed file; shell outputs and checklists supplied by caller.
approval_gates: No success claim without fresh evidence; delegated assertion is insufficient.
costs: Verification commands; repeats if freshness interpreted by message rather than code state.
failure_modes: Over-verifying same unchanged tree; output-tail versus full-output tension; tests mistaken for complete requirements or live safety.
director_action: Adopt evidence-before-claim; core receipts bind command, exit, code hash/time/environment and scope; reuse evidence only for same relevant state.
verification: static source analysis; upstream scripts/hooks/tests not executed

name: writing-plans
activation: Spec/requirements exist for multi-step work before code.
workflow: Map files/responsibilities; right-size independently testable tasks; exact interfaces/tests/commands; global constraints and review focus; self-review; link plan and choose/preserve execution route.
inputs: Approved spec, actual project patterns, constraints, execution preference.
outputs: Unambiguous implementation plan and selected native/SDD route.
artifacts: docs/superpowers/plans/YYYY-MM-DD-feature.md; Goal, Architecture, Stack, Spec, Global Constraints, Review Focus, Task sections.
approval_gates: Plan review before implementation; preserve previously selected execution method.
costs: Planning context/source reads, self-review; no planner-review subagent required; optional human round trip.
failure_modes: Overlong transcript-like plan or vague steps; copied signatures drift; review-focus section calls inputs uncovered then adds tests, so reviewer must inspect residual risks.
director_action: Adopt task/interface/test structure; core stores machine task DAG and checked plan revision; preserve authorization and avoid repeated method questions.
verification: static source analysis; upstream scripts/hooks/tests not executed

name: writing-skills
workflow: Baseline pressure scenario without guidance; record failures; minimal skill; same scenario with guidance; refactor; wording micro-tests no-guidance control 5+ reps; deployment checklist.
inputs: Reusable failure pattern, realistic harness context, pressure scenarios, baseline outputs.
outputs: Versioned behavior guide with evaluated triggering/compliance and references.
artifacts: SKILL.md plus heavy references/tools; test/eval evidence; optional Graphviz diagrams via render-graphs.js.
approval_gates: Failing baseline before content edits; every skill individually checked; deployment mentions commit/push/fork but host owner policy governs.
costs: At least baseline+guided samples plus 5+ micro-test reps per variant for behavior shaping; repeated pressure runs; optional Node+dot rendering.
failure_modes: High authoring/eval overhead; five reps not robust validation; model-specific prompt overfit; auto push exceeds authorization; render output writes into skill tree.
director_action: Optional skill-maintenance workflow; evaluate on held-out tasks/models, cap spend; distribution/signing/release approvals in core; no autonomous self-install.
verification: static source analysis; upstream scripts/hooks/tests not executed
